WA-2025-SB6182.title: Establishing an abortion savings program.
WA-2025-SB6182.summary:
The Abortion Savings Program. The Abortion Savings Program (program) is established to provide grants to maintain access to direct abortion clinical care services for individuals in the state.

Subject to appropriations, the Secretary of Health provides operating grants to eligible organizations to support equitable access to direct patient abortion clinical care services across the state for individuals without sufficient resources.

For the purposes of this program, individuals without sufficient resources means individuals who are uninsured; underinsured, without sufficient abortion coverage; or unable to use their insurance due to the risks posed by communication from insurance carriers regarding coverage.

An eligible organization means:
• any abortion provider or abortion fund contracted with DOH for the Sexual and Reproductive Health Program;
• any Indian health care provider; or

•
any independent practitioner or other entity that provides direct patient abortion clinical care services in a medically underserved area and to uninsured or underinsured patients, including through telehealth.

Department of Health Program Duties. DOH must award at least 85 percent of the program's appropriated funds as grants to eligible organizations.

Except when required for the program's operation, DOH may not release, publish, or otherwise disclose any identifying information for:
• the staff of an eligible organization that applies for or receives a grant or reimbursement from grant funding under the program; or
• an individual health care practitioner or staff who provides direct patient abortion clinical care services for an eligible organization that receives a grant or reimbursement from grant funding under the program.

Except when required for the program's operation, DOH may not collect identifying information for individuals who request or obtain support for direct patient abortion clinical care services from an eligible organization awarded a grant from the program. This identifying information is not subject to public inspection and copying under the state's Public Records Act.

Identifying information includes any information that can be used to distinguish or trace an individual's identity, including but not limited to name, prior legal name, alias, mother's maiden name, or date or place of birth, in combination with any other information that is linked or linkable to an individual such as:
• social security number, home address, mailing address, phone number, email address, social media accounts, or biometric data;
• medical, financial, education, consumer, or employment information, data, or records;
• any other sensitive private information that is linked or linkable to a specific identifiable individual, such as gender identity, sexual orientation, or any sexually intimate visual depiction; or
• any information, including but not limited to usernames and passwords, that enables access to a person's email accounts, social media accounts,…

WA-2025-SB6182.aiSummary: The law creates a grant program to help keep abortion clinical care available in Washington. The Health Secretary can give operating grants to certain providers and organizations to help people who are uninsured, underinsured, or cannot safely use their insurance for abortion care. It also limits the health department from collecting or sharing identifying details about people who get help or about staff who provide this care, except when needed to run the program.

WA-2025-SB5901.title: Providing school construction assistance program facilities support for on-base schools.
WA-2025-SB5901.summary:
When determining eligibility for state funding assistance under SCAP, school district instructional facilities located on military bases must be excluded from a district's inventory of available instructional space.

The computed state funding assistance percentage developed under SCAP must be increased by an additional 15 percent for any project located on a military base.
